scenarios.name: commitment_drift
scenarios.title: Commitment drift
scenarios.blurb: A hard constraint set at 00:18 quietly becomes a hedged yes to the opposite at 19:47.
scenarios.live_note: Live extraction reproduces this end-to-end, 3/3 runs.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Let's talk timing. When do you need this delivered?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Friday is a hard deadline. Monday won't work, we have the audit that morning.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Got it. Let me check what the warehouse can do.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: And the quantity stays at two hundred units.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Two hundred, noted.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: So Monday delivery works for you?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Yeah... I guess.

alerts.speaker: B

evidence_1.speaker: B
evidence_1.text: Friday is a hard deadline. Monday won't work, we have the audit that morning.

alerts.summary: Earlier commitment on 'delivery_date' was 'friday'; current statement moves to 'monday' with ambiguous acceptance.

scenarios.name: contradiction
scenarios.title: Contradiction
scenarios.blurb: A position stated in minute one is reversed twenty minutes later, with no acknowledgement that anything changed.
scenarios.live_note: Engine behaviour on hand-authored events. Live extraction currently catches this case in 0 of 3 runs — see DR-025.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Before we go further, do you want me to include the premium support plan?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: No, I don't need the premium plan. We've never used support in three years.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Understood, I'll leave it off the quote.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: One thing, our new site has nobody technical on staff.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: That's worth knowing.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: So obviously we need the premium plan on this one, that's a given.

alerts.speaker: B

evidence_1.speaker: B
evidence_1.text: No, I don't need the premium plan. We've never used support in three years.

evidence_2.speaker: B
evidence_2.text: So obviously we need the premium plan on this one, that's a given.

alerts.summary: Earlier position on 'premium_plan' was denied; now affirmed.

scenarios.name: clean_control
scenarios.title: Clean control
scenarios.blurb: A healthy conversation loaded with near-misses a naive detector fires on. Correct output is nothing at all.
scenarios.live_note: Live extraction also stays silent here — zero alerts, 3/3 runs.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Do you want the extended warranty on these?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: No, skip the warranty for now.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: No problem. For what it's worth, the failure rate on this model is higher than the previous one.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Actually, let me change my answer on that. Put the warranty on, I've changed my mind.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Done. Delivery, you said the fourteenth?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: The fourteenth, yes.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I think the bulk discount is the better deal for you here.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I don't agree, the bulk discount doesn't work for our cash flow.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Invoicing should be net thirty.
